mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,kind,id,department_id,payload,version FROM ai_hr_configuration_document WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND kind=#{kind} AND id=#{id}
SELECT tenant_id,kind,id,department_id,payload,version FROM ai_hr_configuration_document WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND kind=#{kind} AND department_id IN #{d} ORDER BY id LIMIT 10000
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_configuration_document SET payload=#{row.payload},version=#{row.version} WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND kind=#{row.kind} AND id=#{row.id} AND department_id=#{row.departmentId} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT id,payload,version,created_at AS at FROM ai_hr_configuration_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND kind=#{kind} AND object_id=#{id} ORDER BY version DESC

SELECT id,department_id,kind,object_id,action,actor_id,version,created_at AS at FROM ai_hr_configuration_audit WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND department_id IN #{d} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT 500
SELECT id FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND department_id=#{department} AND status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT 10000
